errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse ist mit "OECD" und "COM vs. 37" beschriftet, wobei die Werte von -1,5 bis 9,5 erstreichen und ein regelmäßiges Tick-Intervall aufweisen. Die horizontale Achse stellt verschiedene Indikatoren dar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the roles of the vertical and horizontal axes. The vertical axis lists the categories (Indikatoren), while the horizontal axis represents the numerical values. The description claims the opposite.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse ist mit "OECD" und "COM vs. 37" beschriftet
errors.evidence: The vertical axis, which shows the categories, is not labeled "OECD" and "COM vs. 37". These are recurring parts of the full category names (e.g., "NEWK OECD vs. 55", "NEWK COM vs. 37"), not labels for the axis itself.
The description claims there is a regular tick interval, but the chart's value axis has no visible tick marks or scale; values are labeled directly on the bars.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in absteigender Reihenfolge ihrer Werte angeordnet
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in descending order. The values from top to bottom are 7.8, 9.5, 1.6, 5.5, etc., which is not a sorted sequence.

errors.text_span: der längste Balken NEWK OECD vs. 55 mit einem Wert von 9,5
errors.evidence: The longest bar, with a value of 9.5, corresponds to the category "NEWK COM vs. 37". The category "NEWK OECD vs. 55" has a value of 7.8.
The list of indicators is incomplete; it omits the category "NEWK COM vs. 37", which corresponds to the highest value in the chart (9.5).
